text:
Maya (docs): quick FYI — I was reviewing the APAC availability matrix and noticed Singapore is missing (ap-southeast-1). Also found an SDK Python snippet using the old alias `apac-sg` which isn't in our alias mapping.
Arjun (product): ouch. which pages?
Maya (docs): sources: docs/regions/apac.md and a few SDK examples under docs/sdk/python/embeddings.md.
Lea (eng): we migrated names last quarter, `apac-sg` got standardized to `ap-southeast-1`. Looks like the docs sweep missed those files.
Maya (docs): propose: add a short alias table to the APAC page and update the SDK examples to use the canonical region code. Example snippet I plan to use: 
```bash
# recommended: explicit region code
client = RedwoodClient(region="ap-southeast-1")
```
Arjun (product): add a one-liner in the page explaining aliases for backwards compat and timeline for deprecation.
Jin (intl): we'll need translations updated too (JP/SG/EN-ZH). I can push the localization keys once the English PR lands.
Priya (legal): don't change any residency language. If you add a line about "regional coverage", avoid legal words like "guarantee" or "sovereign". Instead link to the legal residency page for exact terms.
Maya (docs): noted. I'll link to /legal/data-residency and use neutral wording: "region availability and residency options".
Lea (eng): technical caveat: some Dedicated customers still accept the alias env var `REDWOOD_REGION_ALIAS` for older deployments. Please add a short note: "Legacy Dedicated clusters may accept REDWOOD_REGION_ALIAS."
Maya (docs): ok — short parenthetical under alias table. Also planning to add a tiny changelog note: "Docs: clarify APAC region codes and update SDK examples".
Arjun (product): can we also check status page mappings? We don't want mismatch between docs and status incidents.
Lea (eng): I'll verify the status page config after the PR. If there's a mismatch I'll send a follow-up PR for the status repo.
Maya (docs): created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498 — updates apac.md, fixes SDK snippets, and adds alias table.
Jin (intl): pinged translation platform; translations-bot will create work items once PR merges.
translations-bot: Translation job queued: JOB-8842 (ja, zh, en-SG).
Priya (legal): quick review: wording looks safe, ensure the legal link points to latest version (not archived).
Maya (docs): thanks — @Priya I'll double-check the target URL.
Arjun (product): LGTM pending the status page check and translations flow.
Lea (eng): small nit in the Python snippet: prefer keyword arg `residency="retained"` instead of `residency=retained` to match SDK surface. Also add a comment about what `retained` means (link to legal).
Maya (docs): updated snippet in PR accordingly. New code sample: 
```python
# preferred: explicit region and residency (retained = customer-data stays in-region)
client = RedwoodClient(region="ap-southeast-1", residency="retained")
```
Priya (legal): ok on the phrasing "retained = customer-data stays in-region" as long as it links to the residency policy for exact scope.
Maya (docs): added link and a short migration note: "If your automation sets `apac-sg`, update to `ap-southeast-1` before end of Q3; legacy aliases may linger on older Dedicated clusters."
Jin (intl): once merged I'll export strings for translators.
Maya (docs): merged and deployed; follow-up ticket to sweep other SDK snippets: DOCS-3221.
Arjun (product): good work. Please include a line in next week's release notes so customers see the change.
Maya (docs): will add to release notes. Closing thread ":white_check_mark:" — reopen if anything else pops up.
